patterns.note: Asymmetrical section layouts often pair large, impactful text on one side with a prominent product image or graphic on the other, typically within a dark green full-bleed background.
A high-contrast color scheme uses a dominant deep forest green for backgrounds, paired with crisp white text and a vibrant, almost neon green for calls-to-action and key accent elements.
Headings are set in an oversized, extremely bold sans-serif typeface, creating strong visual hierarchy and impact, while body text uses a clean, legible sans-serif.

Key elements in the hero section, such as the phone graphic and a '5% CASH BACK' badge, exhibit a subtle parallax effect, moving at a different speed than the background as the user scrolls, with the badge then sticking to the top right.

Content sections are clearly delineated by alternating background colors, primarily between the deep forest green and a very light, almost white-green, often featuring card-like elements for testimonials and feature descriptions.

technique_notes: The navigation bar transitions from a transparent overlay with white text to a solid dark green background with a vibrant green CTA button, becoming sticky at the top of the viewport after scrolling past the hero section.
Hero elements, specifically the product phone graphic, are animated to scroll at a slower rate than the page background, creating a subtle depth and parallax effect.
Content sections are revealed with a staggered fade-in and slight upward slide animation as they enter the viewport, drawing attention to new information.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, extremely bold sans-serif headings (hero ~4-5x body text) create strong impact, complemented by clean, legible body text and smaller, often uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (e.g., buttons, cards, phone screens) with a consistent small radius across interactive and display elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density, with an airy hero section providing ample breathing room, transitioning to comfortable spacing between content blocks and a denser layout for legal disclaimers.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, almost monochromatic dark green color palette, punctuated by a vibrant, almost neon green for accents and CTAs, creates a modern, premium, and highly branded feel. This strong color identity, combined with oversized, impactful typography, makes the design immediately recognizable and memorable.
